Rare Corner Lot - First Time on Market in 45+ Years!
This charming Spanish Mediterranean center-patio home is located on a prime Outer Sunset corner lot, offering endless potential. The two-level layout features two separate entrances, each with 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, and a full kitchen. The upper level showcases vintage charm with hardwood floors, beamed ceilings, skylights, an ornate fireplace, and ocean views from the bedroom. Abundant natural light fills the space, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere.
The lower level (unwarranted) provides a spacious, private unit perfect for rental income or extended family. Live upstairs and rent downstairs, or convert it into a large single-family home, endless possibilities in an unbeatable location!
Enjoy a private backyard, just steps from Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, and the shops, restaurants, and Muni access on Judah Street. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity!
